name: Jean-Marc Germain, Monika Hohlmeier - Après le § 9 - Am 9
title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text: 9a. Recalls that there is no legal definition of ‘rule of law’ in the TEU and that each Member State has its own definition, which may vary from one country to another, contributing to legal uncertainty; deplores the fact that this concept is used arbitrarily, in the absence of a definition and a legal basis;
